target.statement: Clustering accuracy (ACC) of LoRD on the Wine dataset (D10), as reported in the main results table.

compute.basis: Wine is a tiny 178x13 dataset; the method is a projected gradient descent with O(n^2 k) per iteration and n=178, k=3, so a few thousand iterations take seconds on CPU; the main cost is installing dependencies and downloading the small dataset.

title: Graph-based Clustering Revisited: A Relaxation of Kernel $k$-Means Perspective
